sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2022 Lamborghini Urus, finished in Nero Noctis with a Nero Ade interior. The odometer on this Urus currently displays approximately 2,200 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Lamborghini’s past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the Style and Upper and Lower Leather packages, 23-inch Taigate alloy wheels in gloss black, carbon ceramic brakes, a panoramic roof, Full Electric Comfort heated and ventilated front seats, a Lamborghini Sensonum sound system, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller are limited to paint protection film on the front end. The Lamborghini Urus arrived in 2018 and almost immediately established itself as one of the most ferocious SUVs in the market. The sharp styling only added to the drama of the Urus, which offers the agility and performance of a sports car combined with surprising off-road abilities. The Urus might not be as utilitarian as the iconic LM002, but it remains an impressively versatile machine that’ll do 190 mph flat out. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V8, rated at 641 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all 4 wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission.
